title: Naming a Generic Type
description: Build a set and a pair on top of generic aliases, and see the property that separates an alias from a defined type: it stays interchangeable with the type it names.
short_description: Get the name without creating a new type
learning_objectives: Write a generic alias and know when to prefer it to a defined type
Explain why an alias needs no conversion at a boundary
Remember that an alias cannot carry methods
real_world_connection: Long generic signatures show up everywhere in handler and repository code, and moving a type between packages without breaking callers is a routine refactor. Both are alias jobs.
requirements: NewSet deduplicates and returns a usable empty set for no items
Union returns a new set and leaves both inputs untouched
Zip pairs values and stops at the shorter slice
bonus_points: Try adding a method to Set and read the compiler error
Change the alias to a defined type and count how many call sites stop compiling
